rows.en: Of course. In that case, we'll call our friends over from the base too.
Sure thing. Then we'll call our friends over from the base too.
Of course! ...Oh, then we'll call our friends over from the base too.
Got it. Then I guess we'll call those guys over from the base too.
Sure. Then I guess we'll call our partners over from the base too.
Good idea. We should share what we know with each other.
Ultraman Hikari and the other heroes gathered from the base,
and the Hero Team and Celestial Being
exchanged every scrap of information they had to deal with this "anomaly."
...I see.
So you were pulled into this world just like we were...

Seravee Gundam.
He is the leader of Celestial Being.
...and came to the "Desert Cube" from the "Begins Cube" via some kind of transfer device. Right?
Yes, that's exactly right.
And it sounds like they're looking for some Kamen Rider pals of theirs.
Kamen Rider 1 and Kamen Rider 2.
But I haven't heard anything that sounds like a lead on Rider 1 or Rider 2.
I see...
Maybe Birth knows something.
Yeah, I'll go get him.
Birth...!?
Yo! What's up, Cherudim, my man?
Birth!!
Huh? Well if it isn't OOO!! So you ended up in this world too, huh?
I'm glad you're safe too, Birth.
Ha ha, is that so, is that so!
You two know each other?
Sure do! We fought side by side back in our world.
But why are you with Celestial Being?
Yup, you bet! I'm still collecting medals so I can make my hundred million.
I got sucked in here, and while I was wandering around, my man Cherudim came and saved me.
We're the ones who owe you. Your medical know-how has saved us time and again.
I may not look it, but I'm a doctor, sort of. Y'know?
Hm? Who's that behind you... No way!!
Well, well! Even Anko's here!
Tch! Leave me out of it! Hurry up and get on with it!
Oh, right... Birth, do you know anything about Kamen Rider 1 and 2?
Apparently they were brought to this Cube.
Hmm... Are you sure it was really this Cube? I'd say it was a different one.
Info from our enemy friends says there's a Cube focused on modifications and experiments,
and word is that test subjects captured in every Cube get shipped there.
Well, I can't say for sure, though.
No, that's plenty.
Since the enemies in every Cube are linked as one organization, we're bound to find some lead.
To do that, we need to storm their headquarters here and expose what the enemy is after.
Cherudim, we have our own reasons to fight. We want to help you.
We want to help you.
Really! It's a big help to hear you say that.
Truth is, we've also got hold of an invasion route into the enemy's headquarters.
But as we are, all we can manage is local resistance and covert scouting of the enemy...
We haven't even managed to take a single area the enemy controls.
But if we can form a united front with you guys, we might be able to break this stalemate.
Good. Then let's draw up an operation plan right away.
Let's see... Could you lend us a strategist from your side as well?
...In that case, I'll take part.
And you are...?
I am Ultraman Hikari.
From what I can see, you're lacking the technology and knowledge of our Ultra Warriors' world here.
Yes, we'd be very grateful for your help.
Understood. Let's work out a plan at once.
All right. This way, then.
Okay, you guys wait around here for now. Don't wander off too far.
Don't wander off too far.
Got something you want to ask? If it's something I know, I'll answer anything.

About the enemy
About Celestial Being
About the enemy HQ
Never mind
The Gaia Cubes seem to be a world rebuilt out of all kinds of worlds that got pulled in.
There are several Cubes, floating in what you might call "another dimension."
But we don't know how many of them there are.
And there's one thing all the heroes who got pulled in have in common...
They've lost the powers they should have had back in their own worlds.
But it looks like those powers didn't vanish. They got absorbed into this world.
In fact, some of our comrades' weapons turned up in the ruins in this Cube.
The enemy calls itself "Regis" as a whole.
Regis is an organization that brings together all the forces that fought heroes in their original worlds.
Why they'd team up, I've got no idea.
But mobile suits really do come at us together with kaijin and kaiju... They're a real pain.
Looks like the enemy's goal in this Cube is developing new forces.
And the basis for that is digging up the "power" sleeping in the Cube.
They grab tech from worlds they'd never normally reach, plus the powers we used to have...
then apply and repurpose it all. That's how they create even nastier forces.

notes.note: #0.271-0.275 continue the unlabelled leader-variant set begun at #0.269 (Zero) and #0.270; voiced by register only: #0.273 polite with ore and a fumbled 'oh' (OOO-like), #0.274 rough 'those guys' (Momotaros-like, same slot as the coffee line in #0.241), #0.275 casual.
One narration sentence cut across #0.279-0.281; English cut at the same points. 'Ihen' = 'anomaly' per earlier slices.
Name caption kept as two lines (name / title), a deliberate layout.
1-go/2-go shortened in the source; used glossary 'Rider 1 / Rider 2'.
No speaker; plain 'I see...' - probably W (Shotaro) or the party leader. Neutral wording.
Birth (Date) adds -chan to Cherudim; honorifics are dropped project-wide, so his chummy tone is carried by 'my man' (also #0.305).
No speaker; read as Birth reacting cheerfully to OOO's 'glad you're safe'. Kept literal repeated 'is that so'.
No speaker; Birth (Date's goal of earning 100 million). It answers a question not in this slice (likely a branch variant of #0.303 asking if he still collects medals); translated as written.
'Anko' kept: Date's teasing nickname for Ankh in the show (anko = sweet bean paste).
'Teki-san' (jokey honorific on the enemy) rendered 'our enemy friends'.
Duplicate of the second half of #0.320 (likely an alternate/unused box); same wording.
No speaker; polite 'wakarimashita, dewa kochira e' - probably Sandrock (polite) or Seravee leading Hikari away. Kept neutral.
Choice menu; kept one option per line. 'Enemy organization' shortened to 'About the enemy', 'enemy base' to 'enemy HQ'.
#0.3-0.9 have no speaker; Cherudim answering the menu (Gaia Cube topic, not listed in this menu).
Bare 'naze ka wa wakaranee' expanded to 'Why they'd team up' so the verb has an object (why the villains of all worlds joined).
Source 'MS' expanded to 'mobile suits' (as in 0206 #0.2); kaijin kept as 'kaijin' per earlier slices.

report: 80/80 examined. 0207#0.2 is a 4-option choice menu (4 lines by design, flagged by checker). Unlabelled rows inferred: leader variants #0.271-0.275, #0.291, #0.300/#0.304 (Birth), #0.349. #0.304 answers a question not present (branch). Birth's -chan rendered 'my man'; 'Anko' kept as Date's nickname for Ankh. No new names outside glossary.
